papers.title: VIOLIN: A modular framework for scalable reconciliation of heterogeneous interaction graphs
papers.translated_title: VIOLIN：用于异构交互图可扩展协调的模块化框架
papers.author: Luo, H.
papers.summary: Automated extraction of molecular interactions from scientific literature has outpaced the development of systematic methods for integrating this information with curated models and knowledge graphs. Here we present VIOLIN (Versatile Interaction Organizing to Leverage Information in Networks), a configurable, attribute-aware reconciliation framework that formally compares newly extracted interaction lists against structured baseline graphs. VIOLIN classifies each interaction as a corroboration, contradiction, flagged case, or extension, and supports configurable attribute inclusion strategies and mismatch semantics to adjust reconciliation strictness. We evaluate VIOLIN using interaction lists generated by two traditional NLP systems (REACH, INDRA) and two large language models (GPT-4.1, Llama 3) across multiple literature corpora and structurally distinct baseline graphs. Across all conditions, reconciliation outcomes were stable and interpretable, with extensions dominating and corroboration-contradiction balance reflecting intrinsic structural relationships between baseline graphs and extracted evidence. Sensitivity analyses demonstrate that attribute inclusion and classification scheme selection shift category boundaries predictably. Benchmark evaluations confirm high algorithmic correctness and alignment with expert curation. VIOLIN is publicly available as a Python package and through web-based interface (https://nmzlab.github.io/Tools-UI).
papers.translated_summary: 从科学文献中自动提取分子相互作用的发展速度，已经超过了将其与人工整理模型和知识图谱进行整合的系统化方法的发展。在此，我们提出VIOLIN（Versatile Interaction Organizing to Leverage Information in Networks），一个可配置、属性感知的对账框架，用于将新提取的相互作用列表与结构化基线图进行形式化比较。VIOLIN将每个相互作用分类为佐证、矛盾、标记案例或扩展，并支持可配置的属性纳入策略和不匹配语义，以调整对账的严格程度。我们使用由两个传统NLP系统（REACH、INDRA）和两个大语言模型（GPT-4.1、Llama 3）在多个文献语料库和结构不同的基线图上生成的相互作用列表来评估VIOLIN。在所有条件下，对账结果均稳定且可解释，其中扩展占主导，佐证与矛盾的平衡反映了基线图与提取证据之间的内在结构关系。敏感性分析表明，属性纳入和分类方案选择会以可预测的方式移动类别边界。基准评估确认了较高的算法正确性以及与专家人工整理的一致性。VIOLIN以Python包形式公开提供，并可通过基于网络的界面访问（https://nmzlab.github.io/Tools-UI）。

papers.title: Bacterial metabolites alter the consequences of reduced insulin signaling in C. elegans via increasing the expression of the acid sphingomyelinase asm-3.
papers.translated_title: 细菌代谢物通过增加酸性鞘磷脂酶asm-3的表达，改变秀丽隐杆线虫中胰岛素信号减弱所带来的后果。
papers.author: Mechan Llontop, M.
papers.summary: Individuals consuming an identical diet often exhibit vast differences in their physiological response to the same nutrients. Studies of identical twins and genetically identical laboratory animals have both shown that much of this variability cannot be explained by differences in genetics. Differences in gut microbes and local microflora have emerged as a leading potential source of this variability, but mechanistic investigations of three-way host-microbe-diet interactions are difficult in most animals. Here, we find that dietary sugar availability suppresses the longevity, dauer formation and gene expression changes of daf-2 (insulin-like receptor) mutants fed Escherichia coli OP50, but not daf-2 mutants fed many other bacteria. To determine how sugar availability and bacteria intersect to affect C. elegans insulin signaling we conducted transposon mutagenesis screens and found that the effects of sugar availability on C. elegans insulin signaling depend on bacterial pyruvate dehydrogenase activity. We further found that reducing bacterial pyruvate dehydrogenase activity results in increased pyruvate and lactate accumulation and induced host expression of the acid sphingomyelinase asm-3. Lastly, we find that asm-3 is required for the loss of pyruvate dehydrogenase activity to alter the phenotype of daf-2 mutants. Collectively, our findings establish a novel link between bacterial pyruvate metabolism and host insulin signaling that is mediated by altering the expression of a host acid sphingomyelinase.
papers.translated_summary: 摄入相同饮食的个体对相同营养素的生理反应往往表现出巨大差异。对同卵双胞胎和基因相同的实验室动物的研究均表明，这种变异性的大部分无法用遗传差异来解释。肠道微生物和局部菌群的差异已成为这种变异性的主要潜在来源，但在大多数动物中，对宿主-微生物-饮食三者相互作用的机制研究较为困难。在此，我们发现膳食糖的可利用性抑制了喂食大肠杆菌OP50的daf-2（胰岛素样受体）突变体的寿命、dauer形成和基因表达变化，但并未抑制喂食许多其他细菌的daf-2突变体。为了确定糖的可利用性和细菌如何相互作用影响秀丽隐杆线虫的胰岛素信号传导，我们进行了转座子诱变筛选，发现糖的可利用性对秀丽隐杆线虫胰岛素信号传导的影响依赖于细菌丙酮酸脱氢酶活性。我们进一步发现，降低细菌丙酮酸脱氢酶活性会导致丙酮酸和乳酸积累增加，并诱导宿主酸性鞘磷脂酶asm-3的表达。最后，我们发现asm-3是丙酮酸脱氢酶活性丧失改变daf-2突变体表型所必需的。总之，我们的研究结果建立了细菌丙酮酸代谢与宿主胰岛素信号传导之间的新联系，该联系通过改变宿主酸性鞘磷脂酶的表达来介导。

papers.title: Efficient permuted intron-exon RNA circularization system based on the LtrB group II Intron from Lactococcus lactis
papers.translated_title: 基于乳酸乳球菌LtrB II组内含子的高效置换内含子-外显子RNA环化系统
papers.author: Castillo, K. D.
papers.summary: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as promising platforms for stable RNA expression and therapeutic applications, but methods for their generation remain limited. Here, we engineered the Lactococcus lactis LtrB group II intron into a permuted intron-exon (PIE) configuration to enable efficient circRNA formation (circLtrB). Among the tested split designs, LtrB domain IV cleavage yielded the highest circularization efficiency. Although LtrB encodes LtrA maturase required for efficient in vivo splicing, in vitro application of LtrA to the PIE constructs resulted in lower circularization efficiency than self-splicing conditions. We further examined circularization under distinct salt conditions and showed that NH4Cl- and KCl-based splicing buffers independently support high circularization efficiencies (>80%), while producing distinct splicing intermediates, indicating ion-specific mechanistic effects on circularization. Extending outer homology arms did not enhance circularization efficiency, demonstrating that efficient circRNA formation in the circLtrB platform is independent of extended exon pairing interactions. Using this system, we generated circRNAs across a range of coding sequence lengths, highlighting its payload flexibility. To optimize translation, we evaluated multiple internal ribosome entry sites (IRES), including Aichivirus, Crohivirus, CVB3, improved EMCV, HRV, and Salivirus, and found that the CVB3 IRES drove the highest translation efficiency. Linear NLuc showed faster decay kinetics, while circLtrB-NLuc exhibited more sustained expression over time. Transcriptome-wide RNA sequencing revealed comparable innate immune responses between circular and linear RNAs. Together, these results establish circLtrB as a versatile and efficient platform for circRNA production, providing mechanistic insight into group II intron-mediated circularization and expanding the toolkit for functional circRNA engineering.
papers.translated_summary: 环状RNA（circRNA）已成为稳定RNA表达和治疗应用的有前景的平台，但其生成方法仍然有限。在此，我们将乳酸乳球菌LtrB II组内含子工程化为置换内含子-外显子（PIE）构型，以实现高效的circRNA形成（circLtrB）。在测试的拆分设计中，LtrB结构域IV切割产生了最高的环化效率。尽管LtrB编码体内高效剪接所需的LtrA成熟酶，但将LtrA体外应用于PIE构建体导致的环化效率低于自剪接条件。我们进一步检测了不同盐条件下的环化，结果表明基于NH4Cl和KCl的剪接缓冲液各自独立支持高环化效率（>80%），同时产生不同的剪接中间体，表明离子对环化机制的特异性影响。延长外侧同源臂并未增强环化效率，表明circLtrB平台中高效的circRNA形成不依赖于延长的外显子配对相互作用。利用该系统，我们在多种编码序列长度范围内生成了circRNA，凸显了其载荷灵活性。为优化翻译，我们评估了多个内部核糖体进入位点（IRES），包括Aichivirus、Crohivirus、CVB3、改进型EMCV、HRV和Salivirus，发现CVB3 IRES驱动了最高的翻译效率。线性NLuc表现出更快的衰减动力学，而circLtrB-NLuc则随时间表现出更持久的表达。全转录组RNA测序揭示环状RNA与线性RNA之间的先天免疫应答相当。总之，这些结果确立了circLtrB作为circRNA生产的通用高效平台，提供了对II组内含子介导环化的机制见解，并扩展了功能性circRNA工程的工具包。

papers.title: A Plasmodium falciparum Pangenome Resource to Drive Structural Variant Discovery and to assist Malaria Control
papers.translated_title: 一个用于驱动结构变异发现并助力疟疾控制的恶性疟原虫泛基因组资源
papers.author: Billows, N.
papers.summary: Plasmodium falciparum, the deadliest causative agent of malaria, harbours extensive structural variation that underlies key biological processes including drug resistance and diagnostic evasion. Here, we present PfPan, a P. falciparum pangenome constructed from 13 geographically diverse high-quality reference genomes using Minigraph-Cactus, adding 4.77 Mb of sequence beyond the 3D7 linear reference. We identify over 5,000 structural variants (SVs) across the reference genomes and demonstrate improved genotyping using the vg toolkit compared to linear reference-based approaches, with comparable performance for small variant discovery. Benchmarking against assembly-derived truth sets confirms pangenome superiority for structural variant detection, particularly at complex and hypervariable loci. Applying PfPan to 878 globally sampled P. falciparum whole-genome sequences, we characterise biologically and clinically relevant SVs, including the complex drug resistance-linked gch1 locus, and explore deletions upstream of the coding sequence for the diagnostic target HRP2. PfPan provides a foundational resource for mitigating reference bias in P. falciparum genomic surveillance and establishes a framework for improved detection of variants associated with drug resistance and malaria control in monoclonal P. falciparum samples that have not undergone selective whole-genome amplification.
papers.translated_summary: 恶性疟原虫是疟疾最致命的致病因子，其基因组蕴含广泛的结构变异，这些变异构成了包括耐药性和诊断逃逸在内的关键生物学过程的基础。在此，我们提出PfPan，这是一个利用Minigraph-Cactus从13个地理上多样化的高质量参考基因组构建的恶性疟原虫泛基因组，在3D7线性参考序列之外增加了4.77 Mb的序列。我们在参考基因组中鉴定了超过5,000个结构变异（SVs），并证明使用vg工具包进行基因分型优于基于线性参考的方法，在小变异发现方面性能相当。与基于组装的真值集进行基准测试证实了泛基因组在结构变异检测方面的优越性，尤其是在复杂和高变位点。将PfPan应用于878个全球采样的恶性疟原虫全基因组序列，我们表征了具有生物学和临床相关性的结构变异，包括与耐药性相关的复杂gch1位点，并探索了诊断靶标HRP2编码序列上游的缺失。PfPan为减轻恶性疟原虫基因组监测中的参考偏倚提供了基础资源，并建立了一个框架，用于改进对未经过选择性全基因组扩增的单克隆恶性疟原虫样本中与耐药性和疟疾控制相关的变异的检测。

papers.title: Novel retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma inverse agonist enhances checkpoint blockade in hepatocellular carcinoma: a preclinical mouse study
papers.translated_title: 新型视黄酸受体相关孤儿受体γ反向激动剂增强肝细胞癌中的检查点阻断：一项临床前小鼠研究
papers.author: Leo, S.
papers.summary: Background and Aims: Neutrophil-associated inflammation is associated with poor outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but tumour-intrinsic regulators of neutrophil recruitment and checkpoint response remain unclear. We evaluated whether inhibiting retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma (RORgamma) alters neutrophil recruitment, programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, and response to PD-L1 blockade. Approach and Results: Survival associations were analysed in The Cancer Genome Atlas HCC cohort. Neutrophil migration toward HCC cells and PD-L1 expression were assessed after RORC silencing or TF-S10 treatment. Immunocompetent mice bearing orthotopic Hep-55.1c tumours received vehicle, TF-S10, anti-PD-L1, or combination treatment. Higher S100A9 and CXCL8 expression was associated with shorter survival (P = 0.000459 and P = 0.0004413, respectively), and tumour-bearing mice had higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratios (P < 0.0001). RORgamma targeting reduced neutrophil migration and intratumoural Ly6G+; infiltration while increasing tumour-cell PD-L1 expression in vitro. Combination treatment reduced endpoint liver tumour volume versus anti-PD-L1 monotherapy (P < 0.01). Half of combination-treated mice had tumour volumes less than or equal to 0.10 cm^3 and none exceeded 1.00 cm^3, compared with 62% of controls exceeding 1.00 cm^3. Histologically, 85% of combination-treated mice had less than or equal to 10% liver tumour involvement, versus no controls. Combination treatment also reduced tumour-associated neutrophil populations and peripheral neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratios. All active treatments reduced pulmonary metastatic burden versus controls, without significant differences among treatment groups; 53% of combination-treated mice had no detectable lung metastases. Conclusions: RORgamma inhibition reduces neutrophil recruitment and increases tumour-cell PD-L1 expression. Combined RORgamma inhibition and PD-L1 blockade improves hepatic tumour control in preclinical HCC and warrants further investigation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：中性粒细胞相关炎症与肝细胞癌（HCC）的不良预后相关，但肿瘤内在调节中性粒细胞募集和检查点反应的调控因子仍不清楚。我们评估了抑制维甲酸受体相关孤儿受体γ（RORgamma）是否会改变中性粒细胞募集、程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）表达以及对PD-L1阻断的反应。方法与结果：在癌症基因组图谱HCC队列中分析了生存相关性。在RORC沉默或TF-S10处理后，评估了中性粒细胞向HCC细胞的迁移和PD-L1表达。携带原位Hep-55.1c肿瘤的免疫健全小鼠接受了溶媒、TF-S10、抗PD-L1或联合治疗。较高的S100A9和CXCL8表达与较短的生存期相关（分别为P = 0.000459和P = 0.0004413），荷瘤小鼠具有较高的中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（P < 0.0001）。靶向RORgamma在体外减少了中性粒细胞迁移和瘤内Ly6G+浸润，同时增加了肿瘤细胞PD-L1表达。与抗PD-L1单药治疗相比，联合治疗减少了终点肝脏肿瘤体积（P < 0.01）。一半联合治疗小鼠的肿瘤体积小于或等于0.10 cm^3，且无一超过1.00 cm^3，而62%的对照组超过1.00 cm^3。组织学上，85%的联合治疗小鼠肝脏肿瘤受累小于或等于10%，而对照组无一例。联合治疗还减少了肿瘤相关中性粒细胞群体和外周中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值。所有积极治疗均较对照组减少了肺转移负荷，各治疗组之间无显著差异；53%的联合治疗小鼠未检测到肺转移。结论：抑制RORgamma可减少中性粒细胞募集并增加肿瘤细胞PD-L1表达。在临床前HCC中，联合抑制RORgamma和阻断PD-L1可改善肝脏肿瘤控制，值得进一步研究。

papers.title: Spatial uncoupling of endothelial calcium signaling from phosphatidylserine externalization in vascular injury
papers.translated_title: 血管损伤中内皮钙信号与磷脂酰丝氨酸外化的空间解偶联
papers.author: Fauver, O.
papers.summary: Ca2+ is both the signal that spreads injury information through the endothelium and the trigger for phospholipid scrambling that makes a membrane procoagulant. How a blood vessel can disseminate the first without broadcasting the second is unknown. Here, we combine single-cell laser injury in endothelial monolayers with imaging of intact mesenteric vessels in vitro and intravital Ca2+ imaging in vivo. Injury generated a coherent Ca2+ wavefront that spread rapidly before progressively slowing and terminating at a reproducible boundary 197 {+/-} 7 m from the wound, engaging 50 {+/-} 8 cells. The first ring of neighboring cells exhibited a distinct response that was prevented by carbenoxolone, whereas propagation beyond this ring required extracellular ATP, purinergic receptor activation, and IP3-dependent Ca2+ release. Wavefront kinematics were consistent with ATP diffusion. In vivo, injury elicited vasoconstriction and bidirectional Ca2+ waves propagating 205 {+/-} 28 m before terminating. Remarkably, despite widespread Ca2+ elevations, phosphatidylserine (PS) externalization remained confined to the wounded cell in monolayers and intact vessels in vitro. In contrast, ionomycin-induced Ca2+ overload exposed phosphatidylserine in nearly all endothelial cells. These findings reveal an unexpected spatial uncoupling between endothelial Ca2+ signaling and phospholipid scrambling, demonstrating that Ca2+ dependent scramblase activation is subject to additional spatial regulation. The endothelium can therefore propagate injury signals across a broad field of cells while maintaining a highly localized procoagulant membrane response.
papers.translated_summary: Ca2+既是通过内皮传播损伤信息的信号，也是触发磷脂 scrambling、使膜具有促凝血性的触发器。血管如何能够传播前者而不广播后者尚不清楚。在此，我们将内皮单层中的单细胞激光损伤与体外完整肠系膜血管成像以及体内活体Ca2+成像相结合。损伤产生了一个连贯的Ca2+波前，该波前迅速扩散，随后逐渐减慢并终止于距伤口197 {+/-} 7 m处一个可重现的边界，涉及50 {+/-} 8个细胞。邻近细胞的第一环表现出独特的反应，该反应可被carbenoxolone阻止，而超出此环的传播则需要细胞外ATP、嘌呤能受体激活和IP3依赖性Ca2+释放。波前运动学与ATP扩散一致。在体内，损伤引起血管收缩和双向Ca2+波传播205 {+/-} 28 m后终止。值得注意的是，尽管Ca2+升高广泛存在，磷脂酰丝氨酸（PS）外化在单层和体外完整血管中仍局限于受伤细胞。相比之下，ionomycin诱导的Ca2+超载在几乎所有内皮细胞中暴露了磷脂酰丝氨酸。这些发现揭示了内皮Ca2+信号传导与磷脂scrambling之间意想不到的空间解偶联，表明Ca2+依赖性scramblase激活受到额外的空间调控。因此，内皮可以在广泛的细胞区域传播损伤信号，同时维持高度局部的促凝血膜反应。

papers.title: Partial lesions of hypocretin neurons of the rat lateral hypothalamus affect wake and sleep regulation under increased sleep pressure
papers.translated_title: 大鼠外侧下丘脑食欲素神经元的部分损伤在睡眠压力增加时影响觉醒和睡眠调节
papers.author: Lebedeva, M.
papers.summary: Hypocretin(orexin)-producing neurons in the lateral hypothalamic area are important for sleep and wake regulation in mammals and their damage in humans manifests clinically as narcolepsy. While in previous studies experimentally induced massive loss of these neurons revealed their physiological importance, small lesions and their manifestations can uncover more subtle features of sleep regulation and help understand the delicate processes in early stages of pathogenesis of narcolepsy. We studied the effects of partial lesions (approximately 30%) of hypocretin producing neurons in the lateral hypothalamus on sleep patterns and EEG in rats. The lesions did not change the normal sleep and wake pattern in undisturbed rats. The effects of lesions manifested under increased sleep pressure after six hours of sleep deprivation, when they led to accelerated dynamics of compensatory slow wave sleep. The lesions also led to a slight decrease in theta frequency in wakefulness and in REM sleep, which we observed during undisturbed sleep and wake behavior as well as after sleep deprivation.
papers.translated_summary: 下丘脑外侧区产生下丘脑分泌素（食欲素）的神经元对哺乳动物的睡眠和觉醒调节具有重要作用，其在人类中的损伤在临床上表现为发作性睡病。尽管此前的研究通过实验性诱导这些神经元的大量丢失揭示了其生理重要性，但小范围损伤及其表现可揭示睡眠调节中更为细微的特征，并有助于理解发作性睡病早期发病机制中的精细过程。我们研究了大鼠下丘脑外侧区产生下丘脑分泌素的神经元部分损伤（约30%）对睡眠模式和脑电图的影响。该损伤未改变未受干扰大鼠的正常睡眠和觉醒模式。损伤效应在六小时睡眠剥夺后睡眠压力增加时显现，导致代偿性慢波睡眠的动力学加速。该损伤还导致觉醒期和快速眼动睡眠期θ频率的轻微降低，我们在未受干扰的睡眠和觉醒行为中以及睡眠剥夺后均观察到了这一现象。

papers.title: Artificial hibernation uncovers distinct interaction dynamics in functional and pathological state change
papers.translated_title: 人工冬眠揭示功能性与病理状态变化中不同的交互动态
papers.author: Mercier, D.
papers.summary: Neural population activity can reorganize without disrupting function, but how such changes differ from those associated with pathology remains unknown. Artificial hibernation, Q-neuron-induced hypothermia and hypometabolism (QIH), causes extensive synaptic remodeling in the hippocampus without erasing established memories, allowing us to examine how extensive network reorganization can occur without lasting functional impairment. Longitudinal calcium imaging showed that hippocampal activity recovered after QIH without returning to its pre-hibernation population configuration. Instead, QIH reorganized neuronal activity patterns and coactivity beyond representational drift. Electrophysiological recordings revealed that this reorganization of neuronal interactions depended on the preceding network state. In mice subjected to kainic acid-induced status epilepticus, QIH reduced seizure-associated increases in neuronal interactions and spike coactivity during sharp-wave ripples. Over the following 50 days, the divergence of hippocampal LFP trajectories was constrained, and the progressive development of electrophysiological and histological pathology was attenuated. These findings suggest that controlled, extensive reorganization of neural population activity can prevent the progression toward pathological network states, with changes in neuronal interactions, particularly sharp-wave ripple-associated coactivity, accompanying this process.
papers.translated_summary: 神经群体活动可以在不破坏功能的情况下进行重组，但这种变化与病理相关变化之间的差异仍不清楚。人工冬眠，即Q神经元诱导的低体温与低代谢（QIH），会在海马中引起广泛的突触重塑，却不抹除已建立的记忆，这使我们得以研究广泛网络重组如何在没有持久功能损伤的情况下发生。纵向钙成像显示，海马活动在QIH后恢复，但并未回到冬眠前的群体构型。相反，QIH在表征漂移之外重组了神经元活动模式和共活动。电生理记录揭示，这种神经元相互作用的重组依赖于先前的网络状态。在海人酸诱导的癫痫持续状态小鼠中，QIH减少了癫痫相关的神经元相互作用增加以及尖波涟漪期间的放电共活动。在随后的50天里，海马LFP轨迹的发散受到约束，电生理和组织学病理的渐进发展被减弱。这些发现表明，对神经群体活动进行受控的广泛重组可以阻止向病理网络状态的进展，而神经元相互作用的变化，特别是与尖波涟漪相关的共活动，伴随这一过程。

papers.title: Disentangling evoked and induced activity from single-trial neurophysiological time series
papers.translated_title: 从单试次神经生理时间序列中分离诱发活动和诱导活动
papers.author: Ahola, O.
papers.summary: Evoked and induced responses are fundamental neurophysiological readouts in the development and assessment of treatments for disorders with impaired neural function. Distinguishing these responses is essential for interpreting single-trial variability, identifying the determinants of these responses, and enabling real-time probing of cortical responsiveness. However, because of dynamic overlap, separating evoked and induced activity remains unsolved at the single-trial level when instantaneous fluctuations of cortical responsiveness are of interest. We developed the Evoked-Ongoing/Induced Separator (EOIS), a framework for separating event-evoked, ongoing, and event-modulated induced activity from single-trial data. EOIS recovers evoked and ongoing/induced components by leveraging their distinct phase-consistency features in MEG and real-time EEG, enabling subject-agnostic single-trial time-series analysis and attribution of cortical response variability to specific components. By delivering component-resolved time series, EOIS enables biomarker refinement, pharmacodynamic readouts, and closed-loop neuromodulation, facilitating translational deployment across individuals and care settings.
papers.translated_summary: 诱发电反应与诱导反应是神经功能受损疾病治疗开发与评估中的基本神经生理学读出指标。区分这两类反应对于解读单试次变异性、识别这些反应的决定因素以及实现皮层反应性的实时探测至关重要。然而，由于动态重叠，当关注皮层反应性的瞬时波动时，在单试次水平上分离诱发活动与诱导活动仍未得到解决。我们开发了诱发-持续/诱导分离器（EOIS），这是一个从单试次数据中分离事件诱发活动、持续活动和事件调制诱导活动的框架。EOIS通过利用MEG和实时EEG中诱发成分与持续/诱导成分各自不同的相位一致性特征来恢复这些成分，从而实现与受试者无关的单试次时间序列分析，并将皮层反应变异性归因于特定成分。通过提供成分解析的时间序列，EOIS能够支持生物标志物优化、药效学读出和闭环神经调控，促进在个体和护理环境中的转化部署。

papers.title: Predicting alcohol consumption from resting-state functional connectivity: Feature relevance and the potential of meta-matching.
papers.translated_title: 基于静息态功能连接预测酒精消费：特征相关性与元匹配的潜力。
papers.author: Bottino, M.
papers.summary: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is among the most prevalent mental disorders. Associations between resting-state fMRI functional connectivity (FC) and AUD have been reported but rarely replicated. In this preregistered study, we investigated the extent to which FC predicts alcohol consumption, as measured by the AUDIT-C score, in a large sample of non-treatment-seeking alcohol consumers (N = 739), including 528 participants with varying degrees of AUD severity. To optimize performance, we compared kernel ridge regression (KRR) trained directly on this sample with transfer-learning models based on multilayer meta-matching embeddings, from which we derived data-driven relevance maps at the connection, region, and network levels. We tested split-half reliability, reproducibility across cohorts, and outcome specificity of the relevance maps. Both models predicted AUDIT-C scores moderately but significantly (r {approx} 0.15). Meta-matching did not outperform KRR in prediction. Relevance maps showed limited split-half reliability, consistent with the modest predictive performance, but reproduced moderately well across two independent cohorts. These maps indicate reduced connectivity among limbic regions, the anterior middle temporal gyrus, the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex, and dorsal attention network regions. In contrast, hypothesized hyperconnectivity patterns involving the striatum, anterior cingulate cortex, and precuneus were less reliable and mostly non-significant. Overall, our findings suggest that resting-state FC contains reproducible but weak signals related to alcohol consumption. Transfer learning improved relevance-map reliability but not prediction performance and reduced outcome specificity. These results support the utility of interpretable machine learning for identifying connectivity patterns related to drinking behavior, while also highlighting current limitations in its predictive power.
papers.translated_summary: 酒精使用障碍（AUD）是最常见的精神障碍之一。静息态功能磁共振成像功能连接（FC）与AUD之间的关联已有报道，但很少被重复验证。在这项预注册研究中，我们在一个大型的非寻求治疗饮酒者样本（N = 739）中，考察了FC在多大程度上能够预测酒精消费（以AUDIT-C评分衡量），该样本包括528名具有不同程度AUD严重性的参与者。为优化性能，我们将直接在该样本上训练的核岭回归（KRR）与基于多层元匹配嵌入的迁移学习模型进行了比较，并由此在连接、区域和网络层面推导出数据驱动的相关性图谱。我们检验了相关性图谱的分半信度、跨队列可重复性以及结局特异性。两个模型对AUDIT-C评分的预测均为中等但显著（r ≈ 0.15）。元匹配在预测方面并未优于KRR。相关性图谱显示出有限的分半信度，这与中等的预测性能一致，但在两个独立队列之间具有中等程度的可重复性。这些图谱表明，边缘系统区域、前部颞中回、背内侧前额叶皮层以及背侧注意网络区域之间的连接减弱。相比之下，涉及纹状体、前扣带皮层和楔前叶的假设性过度连接模式可靠性较低，且大多不显著。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，静息态FC包含与酒精消费相关的可重复但微弱的信号。迁移学习提高了相关性图谱的可靠性，但未提高预测性能，且降低了结局特异性。这些结果支持可解释机器学习在识别与饮酒行为相关的连接模式方面的效用，同时也凸显了其预测能力目前的局限性。
